name: Flapcount
summary: A newsletter signup that posts your email as a ticket into a split-flap board that greets you by name
about: A retro newsletter card with a navy split-flap reader board. When you subscribe, your address lifts out of the field as a paper ticket and slides into the slot on the board. The board jolts, its lights chase, the message row clatters through letters, the reader count flips up by one and the board says hi to you by name with confetti. Now and then another reader joins on their own. It suits newsletters, waitlists, blogs and launch pages.
how: Type your email and press Subscribe or Enter. A broken address shakes the field and the board flips to CHECK EMAIL.
The button sinks, and your address lifts out as a paper ticket that arcs up to the slot.
The ticket slides into the slot, the board jolts, the lights chase and the message row shuffles to SIGNING UP.
The reader count flips up by one, the board greets you by your first name and confetti flies.
The board settles on SEE YOU SUN, then the next issue time, and the button springs back. The same address twice says ALREADY IN.
